scope: exact within-layer finite-state interactions at fixed Full q/text; globally optimal only for the separable local sum-SSE surrogate

metadata.residual_unit_cost: popcount(combo), one K or V residual unit per bit
metadata.objective: sum over layers of equal-document/equal-phase fixed-Full-q local W_O output SSE
metadata.deployment_scope: retain only the chosen strategy table; if all tables are retained, charge all three
metadata.omitted_mechanisms: cross-layer state feedback, end-to-end answer loss, and finite-precision full-model nonlinearities

membership.weighting: events mean within source document/layer/phase; phase means equal; document means equal; sum layers

budget_semantics: deployed tables are exact-budget; at-most-DP is reported only, not included as a deployment table
optimization_guarantee: DP <= each feasible heuristic under the same local objective; no universal order between conditional greedy and singleton
